_meta.last_swept: 2026-08-26 (T108): ALL 8 rows notified. Honest limits recorded per row (free-text names, opt-in push).

events.finding: FIXED 2026-08-25 (T108): assignment edits now call the guarded notify_wo_assigned RPC (mig 004: member-of-hive caller, recipient resolved from the entry row, self-assign no-op, fixed copy, deep link /logbook.html?status=Open) -> outbox -> notify-push. PROVEN: 'AHU-001 was assigned to you by Leandro Marquez' enqueued. HONEST LIMITS recorded: wo_assigned_to is free text - a name matching no active member resolves to nothing; push reaches opt-in subscribers only. The free-text->member-picker upgrade remains the deeper fix.

FIXED 2026-08-26 (T108): notify_post_mentions (mig 20260826000002) - the mention array was ALREADY stored on both the create and the edit path and painted by renderContentWithMentions, so being named was a first-class fact that reached everyone except the person named. The RPC resolves the named ACTIVE members server-side, drops the author (naming yourself is not news), and deep-links community.html?post=<id>. PROVEN both ways: a mention pushes, a self-mention is silent. HONEST LIMIT: matched on worker_name, so an @name matching no active member reaches nobody - the same free-text limit wo_assigned_to carries.

FIXED 2026-08-26 (T108): notify_reply_posted (mig 20260826000002) closes T31's finding - the asker had no way to learn an answer arrived except by coming back to look. The reply insert now returns its id (it did not before, so there was nothing to point a notification at), the RPC resolves the POST's author from it, and a self-reply pushes nothing. PROVEN both ways.

FIXED 2026-08-25 (T108/T24): the notification lives INSIDE report_community_post (mig 005) - fires only on the FIRST flagging (no supervisor spam on repeat reports), recipients = all active supervisors of the post's hive, resolved server-side; no client wiring, no thenable trap. PROVEN: a real member report enqueued 'A post was reported' to 1 supervisor uid. Reach: opt-in push; the flagged feed remains the always-there surface.

FIXED 2026-08-26 (T108): tg_notify_pending_submission (mig 20260826000003) - a TRIGGER, not a call site, because pending rows come from six-plus paths across five pages including a bulk CMMS upsert, and a missed path is invisible. The realtime subscription on hive.html remains as the live in-board signal; the trigger is what reaches a supervisor who is anywhere else. Copy names NO row so the 2-minute dedupe collapses a bulk import to ONE push (PROVEN: 20 rows -> 0 additional pushes), and the body is wrapped so a broken notifier can never cost someone their submission (PROVEN by renaming enqueue_user_push away: the write still landed).

FIXED 2026-08-25 (T108): approve/reject now call the guarded notify_submission_decided RPC (supervisor-of-the-hive verified server-side, recipient resolved from the item row, fixed copy) -> service_outbox -> notify-push; reaches submitters who enabled alerts (opt-in web push). The rejection push names the way forward ('open Inventory to see why, fix it, resubmit'), pairing the rejection_reason card. supabase-js lesson en route: rpc builders are THENABLES - un-awaited fire-and-forget never sends; .then() attached.

FIXED 2026-08-26 (T108): notify_reply_accepted (mig 20260826000002). The RPC re-reads is_accepted, so only the ACCEPT direction announces and a flip-back sends nothing; accepting your own reply is silent. PROVEN both ways (un-accepted reply stays silent, accepted pushes to the reply's author).

WIRED 2026-08-25 (T108): supervisor-reset-password now enqueues a SECURITY push to the worker ('Your password was reset... If this wasn't arranged with you, tell your supervisor immediately') via the outbox, edge-side beside its audit insert - an unauthorized reset becomes visible to its victim. LIVE-PROOF DEFERRED to the close with a THROWAWAY account (a live test resets real fixture credentials); the code path mirrors the proven audit-insert two lines above. Fn redeploy rides the release.
